name: Send LinkedIn connect outreach
description: Connect-only by default: send LinkedIn connection requests (optional note) for drafted leads. Email only if LEAD_SEND_EMAIL=true. Default dry-run — not in pipeline.

env.name: LEAD_DRY_RUN
env.description: When true, open connect UI but do not send

env.name: LEAD_SEND_ADD_NOTE
env.description: Add LinkedIn connection note from drafted message

env.name: LEAD_SEND_EMAIL
env.description: Opt-in Gmail send when person.email exists (default off)

env.name: LEAD_SEND_MAX
env.description: Max leads to process this run
